displayPattern: 7-segment display on a *CVC96 or *MVC96 two-stage furnace covered by IOG-2015L, including Amana AMVC96 and ACVC96: EE3. The circulator blower runs continuously and there is no furnace operation
meaning: Primary limit circuit is open. The chart lists insufficient air over the heat exchanger.
causes: Improper circulator blower speed or a failed circulator blower motor
Loose or improperly connected wiring in the high limit circuit
diySteps: With the furnace switched off, check the filter and replace it if it is blocked. Open supply and return registers that are shut
Technician: check circulator blower speed and performance, and the high limit circuit wiring
safetyNote: If you smell gas, do not touch any electrical switch or use a phone in the building; leave immediately and call your gas supplier from outside. Turn off electrical power at the furnace switch or breaker before opening any panel, and never bypass or jumper a limit, rollout or pressure switch. Gas valve, burner, venting, wiring and control-board work should be done by a licensed HVAC technician.
proAdvice: Call a licensed HVAC technician if EE3 returns after the filter is clean and the registers are open.
sourceTitle: Amana and Goodman *CVC96 / *MVC96 two-stage furnace installation instructions (IOG-2015L)
